dedupe_keys.name: data set for finding equivalence of layout independent water distribution network for expansion reorganization using nonlinear multi port thevenin theorem

description: Raman Balireddy and colleagues at IIT Madras publish network and circuit files for testing nonlinear multi-port Thevenin equivalents of water-distribution networks. The July 2023 deposit exposes individual INP network files, Verilog-A models, generated C++ files, circuit schematics and numerical results. File names identify 28-pipe, 71 and Richmond cases and several altered connecting conditions. These are modelling examples; the brief metadata leave their exact geographical coverage, simulation periods and units unknown. Access is free under CC BY 4.0. The files could support comparisons of full and reduced hydraulic-network simulations for expansion planning. A separate RAR deposit, Zenodo 8133425, has the same manuscript identity and is treated as an alternative bundle of this resource, without claiming byte identity. The named benchmark workflow concerns model reduction; compiled DLL compatibility and required circuit-simulator versions remain unknown. Related catalogue context is model-epanet, whose INP convention matches the listed network files but was not executed here.
